simple.meaning: צַעֲקָה (tsaʻăqâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a shriek.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 21 times in Genesis, Exodus, 1 Samuel, Nehemiah, Job, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 18:21. The surrounding contexts include family, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צַעֲקָה (H6818) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צַעֲקָה (tsaʻăqâh) / H6818 is traced through Genesis 18:21, Genesis 19:13, Genesis 27:34, Exodus 3:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6818. tseaqah צְעָקָה noun feminine cry, outcry (older form of זְּעָקָה ); — absolute ׳צ Gen 27:34 +; construct צַעֲקַת Exod 3:9 +; suffix צַעֲקָתוֺ 1Sam 9:16 +, etc.; — 1 outcry against (Sodom) Gen 18:21 ; 19:13 (both J). 2 cry of distress especially as heard by ׳י Exod 3:7 (J), 22:22 (E), compare Isa 5:7 ; Job 27:9 ; 34:28 ; Psa 9:13 ; ׳צ אֵלַי בָּאָה Exod 3:9 (E), 1Sam 9:16 , compare Job 34:28 ; ׳צ גְּדֹלָה Exod 11:6 ; 12:30 (both J), Neh 5:1 ; as accusative of congnate meaning with verb Gen 27:34 (J); צ ׳קוֺל 1Sam 4:14 ; Jer 25:36 (|| יְלָלָה ), Zeph 1:10 (|| id. , + גדול שֶׁבֶר ), Jer 48:3 (|| גדול וָשֶׁבֶר שֹׁד ), compare 49:21 ; שֶׁבֶר צַעֲקַת 48:5 ; (|| בְּכִי ).
